content.title: Bill Murray’s Son Is Leaving UConn: Why Luke Murray’s Boston College Hire Matters
content.text: Getty Bill Murray’s connection to UConn basketball is more than a celebrity shot in the crowd. His son, Luke Murray, has been one of Dan Hurley’s assistant coaches since 2021, and he is now leaving UConn to become Boston College’s next head coach.That is the real reason fans searching for Bill Murray during UConn’s NCAA tournament run keep running into Luke Murray’s name. As UConn plays in its biggest game of the season during the NCAA Champioship vs. Michigan on Monday, April 6, fans will be seeing one of the most iconic actors in America.For casual viewers, the family connection is the obvious hook. For UConn fans, though, the bigger story is that Luke Murray has held a meaningful role on one of the most successful staffs in college basketball.GettyWASHINGTON, DC – MARCH 29: UConn assistant coach Luke Murray looks on prior to a game against the Duke Blue Devils in the Elite Eight of the 2026 NCAA Men’s Basketball Tournament at Capital One Arena on March 29, 2026 in Washington, DC. (Photo by Patrick Smith/Getty Images) Luke Murray Has Been a Key Part of Dan Hurley’s StaffLuke Murray is not just “Bill Murray’s son.” He has built a long coaching résumé, with stops at Wagner, Towson, Rhode Island, Xavier and Louisville before joining Hurley’s staff at UConn.At UConn, Murray has been tied to scouting, player development, recruiting and the offensive side of the program. That matters because this is not a case of a famous last name drawing attention to someone on the edge of a bench. He has been part of the operation behind one of the sport’s premier programs.That is the first thing readers need answered when they search his name during a UConn game: Luke Murray is a real figure inside the Huskies’ success story, not just a celebrity relative who happens to be nearby.The Boston College Hire Means Fans Could See Bill Murray at a new Venue Next SeasonMurray’s move to Boston College gives the story actual news value beyond March Madness curiosity. He is not just appearing on camera because of his father. He is making a major career jump.It will be Murray’s first head coaching job in college basketball, marking a big moment in a career that has spanned decades, beginning in 2007-08 at Quinnipiac. He graduated in 2007 from Fairfield University with a degree in sociology.Why Viewers Keep Looking Up Bill Murray During UConn GamesWhen Bill Murray appears during a UConn broadcast, a lot of casual viewers have the same question: why is he there?The answer is simple. He is there supporting his son, who has been on Hurley’s coaching staff and is now headed to Boston College. That connection naturally drives interest during high-profile games, especially in the NCAA tournament when celebrity crowd shots get extra attention.But the best version of the story pivots quickly from the celebrity angle to the basketball angle. The click may come from Bill Murray’s name, but the substance has to come from Luke Murray’s coaching rise.Why the Move Matters for UConn and Boston CollegeFor Boston College, this is a bet on a first-time head coach who comes from a winning program and has been part of high-level staff work.For UConn, it is another reminder that sustained success usually leads to turnover on the coaching staff. Programs that win big tend to lose assistants to larger opportunities, and Murray’s exit fits that pattern.So for anyone searching during the game, the short answer is straightforward: Bill Murray’s son, Luke Murray, is a key UConn assistant who is leaving to become Boston College’s next head coach.That family tie may bring people in. The real story is that Luke Murray is leaving UConn to become a head coach and futher his own basketball story.
